meta.name: upMVC SaaS Pack Knowledge
applies_when: Project is upMVC-SaaS or a product app consuming the pack

three_pieces.bitshost/upmvc: Core framework kernel — routing, config, middleware, module discovery, Application registry
three_pieces.bitshost/upmvc-saas-pack: Tenancy modules + Harvest ops libraries (MailGateway, Notify*, Audit, Totp, Attention, i18n)
three_pieces.host_app: Starter (upMVC-SaaS) or product (e.g. myCMMS) — requires both, owns domain modules

request_flow: Router + middleware → pack or app module controller
architecture.boundary_rule: If multiple SaaS products need it before domain logic → pack. Vertical-only or heavy SDK → new pack or app module.

provider.register: Adds module paths, migration paths (001+002), protected routes
provider.boot: Registers tenant middleware and feature:* factory

module_paths.app: src/Modules (optional — create for local overrides / domain)
module_paths.order: Pack scanned first, app modules last — app wins on route conflicts

pack_modules.note: Pack ships under vendor/.../src/Modules/. App domain under src/Modules/Api/Modules/{Domain}/ — literal Modules segment required by kernel glob
pack_modules.pack_api_modules: Api/Modules/Auth, Api/Modules/Plans, Api/Modules/Tenants, Api/Modules/Admin, Api/Modules/PlatformOps, Api/Modules/I18n
pack_modules.pack_web_modules: Auth, Home, PlatformAdmin, TenantApp, TenantShop, Mail

routes.Api/Modules/PlatformOps: Thin Harvest ops APIs — apps override for domain Attention

harvest.summary: Ops kernel lifted into BitsHost\UpmvcSaas\* so products share mail/notify/audit/MFA/Attention/i18n without domain coupling

namespaces.Mail\\MailGateway: Platform SMTP + plan-gated tenant SMTP + .env fallback + email_log
namespaces.Security\\SecretBox: AES-256-GCM seal for SMTP passwords; dual-unseal read bridge
namespaces.Security\\Totp: RFC 6238 platform MFA; dual-unseal read bridge
namespaces.Notify\\NotifyRegistry: Empty in pack — apps register types at boot
namespaces.Notify\\NotifyGate: Global pause / kill switch per type
namespaces.Ops\\Attention: Generic Attention items (SMTP, email fails, scheduler, flags)

harvest.migration: 002_saas_ops_layer.sql — platform_settings, smtp_settings, email_log, audit_log, notification_*, i18n_overlays, optional users.totp_*
harvest.thin_extend: Harvest kernel classes are NOT final — products may extend (e.g. App\Cmms\MailGateway extends BitsHost\...) to keep call-site namespaces stable

dual_unseal.rule: seal() writes pack pepper only; unseal() also tries legacy myCMMS peppers so path upgrades do not brick existing rows
dual_unseal.never: Do not remove legacy peppers without a migration plan after all known consumers re-saved secrets

deliberately_out: Full PlatformAdmin UI tabs (apps override shells)
AI translate (after overlays proven in production)

tenant.usage: ['tenant'] on web shell routes — not required on standard JWT tenant APIs

feature.usage: ['feature:efactura'] as 4th addRoute argument — plan feature gating

cors.note: Enable CORS_ENABLED=true in .env for cross-origin clients. Route-level 'cors' tag is not a substitute for global CORS config.

tenancy.model: Shared database, shared schema — rows filtered by tenant_id

context_in_controller.jwt_tenant_api: $this->user['tenant_id'] from JWT — primary source for tenant-scoped API queries
context_in_controller.shortcut: $this->tenantId on SaasApiController — populated from current_tenant row when tenant middleware ran

api_module_pattern.model: All tenant queries scoped: WHERE tenant_id = :tid using $this->user['tenant_id'] on JWT APIs

domain_module_contract.description: Your SaaS-specific code — only layer you write per product
domain_module_contract.location: src/Modules/Api/Modules/{Domain}/ (app repo — not inside vendor pack)
domain_module_contract.discovery_warning: Depth matters. InitModsImproved scans */Routes/Routes.php, */Modules/*/Routes/Routes.php and */Modules/*/Modules/*/Routes/Routes.php only. src/Modules/Api/{Domain}/ is NOT discovered and fails silently.
domain_module_contract.notify_types: Register into BitsHost\UpmvcSaas\Notify\NotifyRegistry from an app service provider — never ship product type catalogs in the pack

lessons_from_production: BaseModel CRUD method names may conflict — use app-level AppBaseModel wrapper if needed
Use dispatch() pattern on API controllers for multi-verb routes instead of manual REQUEST_METHOD checks
Split large View.php into Views/ partials when exceeding ~400 lines
RateLimiter (file-based) preferred over session-only Security::rateLimit for login/signup
Validate input at controller boundary — model receives clean typed data
Dual-unseal is a read bridge — after unseal+re-save, seal() stores pack pepper only
Do not re-add final on Harvest classes while products thin-extend them
